Nioh 3 Ninja Talons Build - Ferocious Claws (Beginner Build)
In this Nioh 3 build guide, we're going to be taking a look at how to put together the Ferocious Claws build using Talons and the Ninja Style as your main setup. I'll be showing you where to place your stats and skills to get the maximum impact from this build, as well as what equipment to use and which Guardian Spirit and Soul Cores to have.
This is an early and mid-game build, meant for players to easily put together from the early parts of the game, and has the potential tobe used all the way to the end of the game with slight adjustments and upgrades.
